claim: Patchline ships a regression guard proving the agent never reintroduces a previously fixed hazard. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the previously fixed hazard claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make agent-regression-guard-gate`.
